result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection in a residential area with a marked crosswalk and a curb ramp featuring tactile warnings. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, there is a lack of visible dedicated pedestrian signals or high-visibility crossing treatments.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signal
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal head is visible at the intersection, requiring pedestrians to interpret vehicular signals which may not provide sufficient crossing time.
hazards.location_in_image: At the signalized corner near the utility pole

interventions.title: Install Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on when it is safe to cross and how much time remains.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing transverse markings to high-visibility continental or ladder style markings to increase driver awareness of the crossing.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection with a marked continental crosswalk and a sidewalk on the left side. The environment is heavily wooded, which may impact sightlines, and the lack of a continuous sidewalk on the right side limits pedestrian connectivity.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Dense vegetation on the right side of the road may obscure pedestrians from approaching drivers, especially around the curve.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway beyond the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Discontinuous Sidewalk
hazards.description: The sidewalk appears to terminate or be replaced by a guardrail on the right side, forcing pedestrians into the roadway or onto unpaved surfaces.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to reduce crossing distance and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: Advance Warning Signage
interventions.description: Install pedestrian crossing warning signs with flashing beacons to alert drivers to the crossing.

result.summary: The intersection features a signalized crossing with marked crosswalks and curb ramps, providing a basic level of pedestrian safety. However, the faded markings and wide corner radii suggest that vehicle speeds and visibility could be improved through design interventions.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk across the side street is significantly worn, making it less visible to motorists.

hazards.name: Wide Corner Radius
hazards.description: The corner design allows for fast vehicle turns, which increases the risk to pedestrians in the crosswalk.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Apply high-visibility continental or ladder-style markings to improve the visibility of the pedestrian crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential street with a marked zebra crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like curb ramps is present, the crossing is uncontrolled and sightlines are partially obstructed by dense vegetation on the right side.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Dense vegetation on the right side of the image may obscure pedestrians waiting to cross from the view of oncoming motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground and midground along the sidewalk edge

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: The marked crosswalk lacks any active or passive traffic control devices like stop signs or signals to ensure driver yielding.

interventions.title: Daylighting and Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim or remove dense vegetation near the crosswalk to improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position before they enter the roadway.
